summary: All 9 lane artifacts (1 backend test, 8 browser checks) covering the 8 acceptance criteria passed. No bugs found.

checks.criterion: Public preview and API ingress are healthy (API contract)
checks.name: test_tscheck_api_root_health.py::test_api_root_returns_hello_world

checks.criterion: StartupDesk reproduces the reference site's multi-page UAE business setup IA under the new brand; navigation reaches Home, Jurisdictions, Licenses, About, Pricing, Contact
checks.name: navigation-reaches-core-pages
checks.evidence: Home shows brand 'StartupDesk' + domain-label 'startupdesk.ae'; nav-link-jurisdictions/licenses/about/pricing/home and footer-link-contact each land on the matching page testid (services-page, licenses-page, about-page, cost-calculator-page, home-page, contact-page) with no blank renders.

checks.criterion: All public inner pages and service content are available (catalog, 5 service details, licenses, calculator, about, contact)
checks.name: inner-pages-render-substantive-content
checks.evidence: Visited service-detail-page-{dubai-free-zone,spc-free-zone,shams-free-zone,mainland,offshore} via catalog cards, each rendering a non-empty heading and visible CTA; footer links to licenses/calculator/about/contact all render substantive testids (license-card-1, calculator-estimate, team-name-1, contact-advisory-form).

checks.criterion: Jurisdiction discovery is interactive (filter by Free Zone/Mainland/Offshore updates cards, opening a card reaches matching detail page)
checks.name: services-filter-and-detail-navigation
checks.evidence: service-filter-free-zone/mainland/offshore toggles catalog grid membership (e.g. mainland/offshore cards absent under free-zone filter); clicking offshore card navigates to service-detail-page-offshore.

checks.criterion: Homepage package selector works (Free Zone/Mainland/Offshore updates price + copy)
checks.name: homepage-package-selector-updates-price
checks.evidence: hero-price cycles AED 4,999 -> AED 14,500 (Mainland) -> AED 6,999 (Offshore) -> back to AED 4,999 (Free Zone) as package-tab-* buttons are clicked.

checks.criterion: Cost calculator works (jurisdiction, visa count, workspace update indicative AED estimate)
checks.name: cost-calculator-updates-estimate
checks.evidence: calculator-estimate progresses AED 12,199 -> 16,700 (Dubai Mainland) -> 25,500 (5 visas) -> 32,000 (Private office), matching basePrice + visas*2200 + office add-on formula; no navigation/errors.

checks.criterion: Contact form validates and succeeds (inline errors then local success confirmation + toast)
checks.name: contact-form-validates-and-succeeds
checks.evidence: Empty submit shows contact-error-name/email/phone; valid tscheck-prefixed name/email/phone submit reveals contact-success-toast and the 'ready for review' confirmation text.

checks.criterion: Responsive navigation works (desktop nav without toggle; mobile toggle opens panel, links route)
checks.name: responsive-navigation-toggle
checks.evidence: At 1280x800 desktop-navigation visible / mobile-menu-toggle-button hidden; at 390x844 the reverse, and clicking the toggle then mobile-nav-link-about opens mobile-navigation-panel and routes to about-page.

checks.criterion: Public preview and API ingress are healthy (browser-facing: preview loads clean, API reachable from it)
checks.name: public-preview-loads-healthy
checks.evidence: Loaded https://startup-desk-preview.preview.emergentagent.com/ with strict console checking enabled (no console/page errors), home-page + brand visible, and in-page fetch of /api/ returned {"message":"Hello World"}.
